name: Trirealm Rift Verdict
effectText: If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; choose 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters with the same Attribute, and either add it to your hand or Special Summon it (you cannot choose monsters with that same Attribute by this effect of "Trirealm Rift Verdict" again this turn), also you cannot activate non-"Trirealm Rift" cards or effects for the rest of this turn. While you have no cards in your Deck, once per battle, during damage calculation, if your "Trirealm Rift" monster battles an opponent's monster: You can change the ATK of that opponent's monster to 0.
